summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title (gated only on is_terminal, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests are unverified.
